description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'UserAPI' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Api'. It extends a base 'Endpoint' class and implements CRUD operations for user management within an HRM system. The class includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting user records, along with validation rules and request handling logic. It leverages traits for services and authentication, and incorporates OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: UserAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing system users, supporting CRUD operations with validation and OpenAPI documentation integration.
